creator_request.text: Use the same text as-is, in sequence, but make the illustrations unique, different in camera angles and visuals, fresh, with clothes that do not repeat. Prefer POV, side shots, and back shots; faces do not need to be visible. Preserve the vibe and feeling.
hard_constraints: do not copy screenshot layouts or Instagram UI
mostly POV, side, back, cropped, or object-adjacent camera angles

interpretation: This package adapts only the seven supplied slides. It does not fill the missing original carousel slides.
reference_use: Screenshots are used as mood, copy, and ordinary-life ritual references only. Final art must not include app chrome, source account handles, engagement icons, carousel dots, screenshot framing, or the same photographic compositions.
